turns.question: What is our net revenue for 1 and 2 October 2026 combined?
turns.answer: Net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) for 1 and 2 October 2026 combined was 1,825.59 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
